lines.text: A longer train! Start at one!
All aboard the number train! The numbers got mixed up. Tap them in order, starting from one!
All five in order! What a superstar!
Can you find five friendly aliens?
Can you find the number three?
Can you spot the number two?
Careful — six and nine love to trick explorers!
Count all the aliens in each bubble!
Count both sides carefully!
Count both sides!
Count carefully! Tap the group with two suns!
Count carefully! Which group has eight stars?
Count down for launch! Three comes first!
Count each group! Which has exactly two?
Count each group, then drag it to its number!
Count each side! More means a bigger number!
Count them one by one!
Drag each number to its matching group!
Eight is a lot! Count each star!
Eight stars! Wow!
Every number has a best friend — a group that's just its size! Drag each number to its matching group.
Fewer means the smaller group!
Find the number seven!
Five aliens saying hello!
Five friendly aliens!
Five shiny stars!
Five stars is more than three!
Five!
Five, four, three, two, one... BLAST OFF! Whoooosh!
Four comets! What a show!
Four is more than one!
Four planets!
Four twinkly stars!
Four!
Four! You know all your numbers!
Hooray! You finished every adventure on Number Nebula! You are a true Star Explorer!
It's the great number quiz! Show me everything you've learned, Explorer. Big numbers ahead!
Keep counting! Four is what we want!
Last one! Find six planets!
Last one! Find the number four!
Last one! Which side has fewer aliens?
Look at both sides! Which has more rockets?
Look for the number five!
Look for the number four!
Look for the number seven!
Look for the number three!
More comets! Tap and count them all!
Nine is more than six!
Nine! Almost at the top!
Now count down from five!
Now find the group with three moons!
Now find the number one!
Now for BIG numbers! Let's count higher than ever before. Tap everything you see!
Numbers are hiding among the stars! When I say a number, tap it as fast as you can!
One is a tall straight line!
One rocket!
One!
One, two, three! The train is rolling!
One, two, three, four! Choo choo!
Rockets count BACKWARDS before they launch! Tap the numbers from biggest to smallest, and blast off!
Seven planets! Can you count that high?
Seven planets! That's so high!
Seven! Great start!
Six aliens are waving! Count them all!
Six comets! Amazing!
Six friendly aliens!
Six is a big number! Count carefully!
Six planets! You're a counting champion!
So many comets! Count every one!
Some groups are big and some are small! Look at both sides and tell me which has more, and which has fewer.
TEN! You found ten! You know ALL the numbers, Explorer!
Tap each comet and count!
Tap each star and count to five!
Tap the numbers in order! One comes first!
Ten has two parts — a one and a zero!
That's one! Number one!
That's two suns!
The biggest one of all! Find the number ten!
The longest train yet! You can do it!
The sorting station is open! Count what's in each group, then drag it to its number!
Three cars!
Three comets flew past!
Three fish!
Three is fewer than six! Fewer means less!
Three ladybugs!
Three stars!
Three!
Three, two, one... blast off!
Time for a counting hunt! Count what's inside each bubble, and tap the group I ask for!
Tricky one! Which side has fewer moons?
Two apples!
Two balloons!
Two comets! Zoom, zoom!
Two is fewer than four! You've got it!
Two looks like a swan swimming!
Two moons!
Two socks!
Two!
Welcome to Number Nebula! Tap a glowing level to play!
Welcome to the Number Nebula, Explorer! Look, comets are zooming by! Tap each one and let's count them together.
Where is the number five hiding?
Where is the number nine?
Which bubble looks fuller?
Which group has four stars?
Which side has more butterflies?
Which side has more planets?
Which side has more stars?
Wow! A new world just landed: Number Nebula! Let's go explore!
Yes! Five is more than two!
Yes! One, two, three moons!
Yes! That's three!
Yes! That's two!
You found five!
